seoTitle: Hair Salon & Barbershop Marketing Guide: Get More Clients
description: Practical marketing for hair salons and barbershops: booking apps, rebooking, referrals, pricing, before-and-after photos and local guides by city.
intro: This guide brings together our broader marketing articles for hair salons, barbershops and beauty businesses. Topics include filling empty slots, rebooking clients, referral programs, pricing, branding, booking software and city-specific advice. It is for owners who want a practical overview of what tends to work before choosing where to put their time and money.

If money is tight, start with the clients you already have: a rebooking habit, a simple referral offer and a booking system that makes it easy to return. Those cost little and compound. Once that is steady, look at ways to attract new clients, such as local search, photos and social media.

Most of this can be done by you or your front desk, particularly rebooking and referrals. Bringing in help makes sense when you are running several chairs or locations, or when you want ads and tracking set up properly. DataLatte offers that support, and the free articles here still work on their own.

faq.q: What is the best marketing for a hair salon?
faq.a: The most reliable starting points are a well-kept Google Business Profile, rebooking clients before they leave, and a simple referral offer. Paid ads and social media can add to that. What works best depends on your area and clientele.

faq.q: How can I fill empty appointment slots quickly?
faq.a: Message past clients through text or email about the specific openings, and share them on your social accounts. Our article on this walks through a few approaches. Results vary, so keep the offer simple and avoid heavy discounting.

faq.q: Which booking app is best for salons?
faq.a: It depends on your size, fees and what you need, such as reminders, deposits or marketing tools. We compare several popular options in separate articles. Check current pricing on each provider's site before deciding.

faq.q: Should I offer discounts to get new clients?
faq.a: Occasionally, but constant discounts can teach clients to wait for a deal. Referral rewards, bundled services or added-value perks are alternatives. See our referral and pricing articles for ideas.
